name: koa-xhock-site
description: Sitio XHOCK by KOA: Eleventy + Pages CMS + Cloudflare Workers

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:local && node functions/test/e2e-local.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply koa-xhock --local -c wrangler.dev.toml
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build && wrangler dev -c wrangler.dev.toml
scripts.test:window: XHOCK_STATUS=auto npm run build && npm run db:migrate:local && node functions/test/e2e-window.mjs
scripts.test:browser: XHOCK_STATUS=open npm run build && npm run db:migrate:local && node functions/test/browser-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:validation: XHOCK_STATUS=open npm run build && npm run db:migrate:local && node functions/test/browser-validation.mjs
